name: SWE-PolyBench
description: SWE-PolyBench is a multi-language benchmark for repository-level, execution-based evaluation of coding agents, covering bug fixes, feature additions, and code refactoring across Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python.
reputation: A newer repository-level coding benchmark for multilingual agent evaluation that is relevant to execution-based SWE research but not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Includes a task and repository-stratified subsample SWE-PolyBench500 and novel metrics based on syntax tree analysis; evaluation harness is fully automated.
